parameters.name: AppGroup
parameters.description: The group to which the application belongs.

parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application. You can specify only one application name in each request.

parameters.name: AppType
parameters.description: The application type. Currently, supported application types include: web, mini program, Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and HarmonyOS.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
